The issue was a simple typo in the `gunicorn/util.py` file at line 435. The code had:

```python
if True:  # not callable(app):
```

This was checking `if True:` which always evaluates to `True`, causing the error to be raised unconditionally, regardless of whether the application object was actually callable or not.

The fix was to change `if True:` to `if not callable(app):`, which properly checks if the application object is not callable before raising the error.

### Root Cause
